paramSetup.title: Game Parameter Setup
paramSetup.description: Default values are recommended. Only adjust if you want to customize.
paramSetup.reloadHint: Reload after backend initialization is complete to get the latest values.

TFR_TARGET.label: Total Fertility Rate (TFR) Target
TFR_TARGET.desc: The birth rate households aim for. Higher values lead to faster population growth.

MARRIAGE_RATE.label: Marriage Rate
MARRIAGE_RATE.desc: Base probability coefficient for citizens getting married. Higher = more marriages.

MIN_CHILDBEARING_AGE.label: Minimum Childbearing Age
MIN_CHILDBEARING_AGE.desc: Minimum age at which births can occur. No births below this age.

MAX_CHILDBEARING_AGE.label: Maximum Childbearing Age
MAX_CHILDBEARING_AGE.desc: Maximum age at which births can occur. No births above this age.

INFLOW_MARRIRD_RATIO.label: Immigrant Household Marriage Rate
INFLOW_MARRIRD_RATIO.desc: Probability that an incoming immigrant household is a married couple.

INFLOW_CHILDREN1_RATIO.label: 1st Child Rate (Immigrants)
INFLOW_CHILDREN1_RATIO.desc: Probability that an immigrant household spawns with 1 child.

INFLOW_CHILDREN2_RATIO.label: 2nd Child Rate (Immigrants)
INFLOW_CHILDREN2_RATIO.desc: Probability that an immigrant household spawns with 2 children.

INFLOW_CHILDREN3_RATIO.label: 3rd Child Rate (Immigrants)
INFLOW_CHILDREN3_RATIO.desc: Probability that an immigrant household spawns with 3 children.

IMMIGRATION_MIN_COUNT.label: Minimum Immigrant Households (per epoch)
IMMIGRATION_MIN_COUNT.desc: Minimum number of immigrant households per epoch. Correction for small cities.

IMMIGRATION_STOP_UNEMPLOYMENT.label: Immigration Stop Unemployment Rate
IMMIGRATION_STOP_UNEMPLOYMENT.desc: Immigration halts when unemployment exceeds this rate.

IMMIGRATION_ADULT_AGE_MIN.label: Immigrant Adult Minimum Age
IMMIGRATION_ADULT_AGE_MIN.desc: Minimum age of adults flowing in as immigrants.

IMMIGRATION_ADULT_AGE_MAX.label: Immigrant Adult Maximum Age
IMMIGRATION_ADULT_AGE_MAX.desc: Maximum age of adults flowing in as immigrants.

LIFESPAN_FACTOR.label: Lifespan Factor
LIFESPAN_FACTOR.desc: Multiplier for maximum citizen lifespan. 1.08 ≈ 100 years, 1.06 ≈ 150 years.

SPACE_SINGLE.label: Single Household Living Space (m²)
SPACE_SINGLE.desc: Minimum living area required by a single-person household.

ADD_SPACE_MARRIED.label: Additional Space for Spouse (m²)
ADD_SPACE_MARRIED.desc: Extra living area needed when a household has a spouse.

ADD_SPACE_CHILDREN.label: Additional Space per Child (m²)
ADD_SPACE_CHILDREN.desc: Extra living area needed per child in the household.

HOUSEHOLD_RENT_INCOME_RATIO.label: Rent-to-Income Ratio (max)
HOUSEHOLD_RENT_INCOME_RATIO.desc: Maximum fraction of household income that can be spent on rent. 0.3 = up to 30%.

HOUSEHOLD_TIGHT_BUDGET_RATIO.label: Minimum Discretionary Income Ratio
HOUSEHOLD_TIGHT_BUDGET_RATIO.desc: Minimum discretionary income ratio a household tries to maintain.

HOUSEHOLD_DECIDE_MOVE_COUNT.label: Epochs to Decide to Move
HOUSEHOLD_DECIDE_MOVE_COUNT.desc: Number of epochs of dissatisfaction before a household decides to relocate.

HOUSEHOLD_SHACK_COUNT.label: Epochs Before Homelessness
HOUSEHOLD_SHACK_COUNT.desc: Number of epochs without housing before a household becomes homeless.

QOL_WEIGHT_NUTRITION.label: QoL Weight: Nutrition
QOL_WEIGHT_NUTRITION.desc: Weight of nutrition satisfaction in the quality-of-life score (auto-normalized).

QOL_WEIGHT_HEALTHCARE.label: QoL Weight: Healthcare
QOL_WEIGHT_HEALTHCARE.desc: Weight of healthcare satisfaction in the quality-of-life score (auto-normalized).

QOL_WEIGHT_ENTERTAINMENT.label: QoL Weight: Entertainment
QOL_WEIGHT_ENTERTAINMENT.desc: Weight of entertainment satisfaction in the quality-of-life score (auto-normalized).

AVERAGE_WAGE.label: Average Wage (baseline)
AVERAGE_WAGE.desc: Reference average wage at simulation start.

AVERAGE_RENT.label: Average Rent (baseline)
AVERAGE_RENT.desc: Reference average rent at simulation start (per day per m²).

MIN_PROFIT_RATE.label: Minimum Profit Rate
MIN_PROFIT_RATE.desc: Minimum profit rate required for a business to stay operational.

SPAWN_PROFIT_RATE_THRESHOLD.label: New Entry Minimum Profit Rate
SPAWN_PROFIT_RATE_THRESHOLD.desc: New businesses only spawn in markets above this profit rate. Prevents oversaturation.

DIVIDEND_PAYOUT_RATIO.label: Dividend Payout Ratio
DIVIDEND_PAYOUT_RATIO.desc: Fraction of corporate profit distributed to households as dividends.

MIN_PRODUCTION_LIMIT.label: Minimum Production Ratio
MIN_PRODUCTION_LIMIT.desc: Minimum production as a ratio of total demand.

MAX_LONGRUN_BONUS_DAYS.label: Long-run Operation Bonus Cap (days)
MAX_LONGRUN_BONUS_DAYS.desc: Maximum days of long-term operation bonus a business can accrue.

EXPORT_COMPETITIVENESS_ZERO_RATIO.label: Export Competitiveness Zero Ratio
EXPORT_COMPETITIVENESS_ZERO_RATIO.desc: How much higher than the external price before export competitiveness hits zero. 0.5 = +50%.

SPAWN_LABOR_CAP_RATIO.label: Spawn Labor Consumption Cap
SPAWN_LABOR_CAP_RATIO.desc: Maximum fraction of surplus labor a new business can absorb at once.

DEVELOPER_PROFIT_RATIO.label: Real Estate Developer Profit Ratio
DEVELOPER_PROFIT_RATIO.desc: Profit ratio for real estate development activities.

INVESTMENT_DEPRECIATION_RATE.label: Equipment Depreciation Rate
INVESTMENT_DEPRECIATION_RATE.desc: Rate at which capital stock depreciates each epoch.

WORK_HOURS.label: Daily Work Hours (h)
WORK_HOURS.desc: Standard number of hours a citizen works per day.

NORMAL_LABOR_UTILITY.label: Normal Labor Utilization
NORMAL_LABOR_UTILITY.desc: Labor utilization rate used in standard price calculation. 1.0 = fully utilized.

HIGH_SKILL_BOUNDARY.label: High-Skill Boundary
HIGH_SKILL_BOUNDARY.desc: Skill level above which a citizen is classified as a high-skill worker.

MAX_BASE_SKILL.label: Maximum Base Skill
MAX_BASE_SKILL.desc: Maximum skill level attainable through elementary education.

MAX_SKILL.label: Maximum Skill
MAX_SKILL.desc: Maximum skill level a citizen can reach including higher education and work experience.

WAGE_OVERSTAFFED_THRESHOLD.label: Overstaffed Wage Cut Threshold
WAGE_OVERSTAFFED_THRESHOLD.desc: Wages are reduced when the overstaffing ratio exceeds this value (labor_surplus / quota).

WAGE_UNDERSTAFFED_THRESHOLD.label: Understaffed Wage Raise Threshold
WAGE_UNDERSTAFFED_THRESHOLD.desc: Wages are raised when understaffing with zero applicants exceeds this value.

ELEMENTARY_START_AGE.label: Elementary Education Start Age
ELEMENTARY_START_AGE.desc: Age at which children begin elementary (primary) education.

ELEMENTARY_END_AGE.label: Elementary Education End Age
ELEMENTARY_END_AGE.desc: Age at which elementary education ends (equivalent to high school graduation).

UNIVERSITY_END_AGE.label: University Graduation / Independence Age
UNIVERSITY_END_AGE.desc: Age at which a citizen completes higher education and becomes independent.

MIN_WORKING_AGE.label: Minimum Working Age
MIN_WORKING_AGE.desc: Citizens below this age are excluded from job seeking and unemployment statistics.

EDUCATION_CAPACITY_PER_FLOOR.label: Education Facility Capacity (per m²)
EDUCATION_CAPACITY_PER_FLOOR.desc: Number of students an education facility can accept per m² of floor area.

SCHOOL_SEARCH_MAX_DISTANCE.label: Max School Search Distance (min)
SCHOOL_SEARCH_MAX_DISTANCE.desc: Maximum commuting distance (in minutes) when searching for a school.

BUILDING_FLOOR_LIMIT.label: High-Rise Cost Surge Threshold (floors)
BUILDING_FLOOR_LIMIT.desc: Construction costs rise sharply above this floor count. Limits skyscrapers.

FLOOR_PENALTY_FACTOR.label: Floor Penalty Factor
FLOOR_PENALTY_FACTOR.desc: Coefficient for the high-rise cost penalty. Higher = smaller penalty for tall buildings.

DEMOLITION_RATE.label: Demolition Efficiency Ratio
DEMOLITION_RATE.desc: How much more efficient demolition is compared to new construction (multiplier).

REAL_ESTATE_SUPPLY_SURPLUS_RATE.label: Real Estate Supply Surplus Rate
REAL_ESTATE_SUPPLY_SURPLUS_RATE.desc: Fraction of surplus supply always maintained in the real estate market.

CONSTRUCTION_DEMAND_SITE_AREA_MIN.label: Development Pulse Site Area Min
CONSTRUCTION_DEMAND_SITE_AREA_MIN.desc: Minimum standard development site area (m²) for the construction demand pulse. Multiplied by the zone's demand density to size each epoch's construction demand.

CONSTRUCTION_DEMAND_SITE_AREA_MAX.label: Development Pulse Site Area Max
CONSTRUCTION_DEMAND_SITE_AREA_MAX.desc: Maximum standard development site area (m²) for the construction demand pulse. Larger values allow bigger single developments.

COLLAPSE_BASE_RATE.label: Collapse Base Annual Rate
COLLAPSE_BASE_RATE.desc: Annual probability of collapse for a building with durability 0.5.

COLLAPSE_SHAPE.label: Collapse Weibull Shape Parameter
COLLAPSE_SHAPE.desc: Higher values cause collapse probability to spike sharply near design lifespan.

MAINTENANCE_DURABILITY_THRESHOLD.label: Maintenance Durability Threshold
MAINTENANCE_DURABILITY_THRESHOLD.desc: Buildings below this durability become eligible for maintenance.

MAINTENANCE_COST_RATIO.label: Maintenance Cost Ratio
MAINTENANCE_COST_RATIO.desc: Maintenance cost as a fraction of new construction cost.

MAINTENANCE_BASE_PROB_ANNUAL.label: Maintenance Transition Annual Probability
MAINTENANCE_BASE_PROB_ANNUAL.desc: Annual probability that an eligible building enters maintenance.

DEMOLITION_DURABILITY_THRESHOLD.label: Paused Building Demolition Threshold
DEMOLITION_DURABILITY_THRESHOLD.desc: Paused buildings below this durability become eligible for demolition.

DEMOLITION_BASE_RATE_ANNUAL.label: Paused Building Demolition Annual Rate
DEMOLITION_BASE_RATE_ANNUAL.desc: Annual probability that an eligible paused building is demolished.

SHUTDOWN_GRACE_PERIOD_DAYS.label: Shutdown Grace Period (days)
SHUTDOWN_GRACE_PERIOD_DAYS.desc: Days after completion during which shutdown checks are waived. Allows tenants to move in.

INITIAL_CONSTRUCTION_DEBT_PER_M2.label: Initial Construction Debt (per m²)
INITIAL_CONSTRUCTION_DEBT_PER_M2.desc: Initial construction debt per m² of floor area (negative reserves).

NOISE_ROAD_TRAFFIC_COEFF.label: Road Traffic Noise Coefficient
NOISE_ROAD_TRAFFIC_COEFF.desc: How much road traffic contributes to the noise heatmap. Higher = louder roads.

NOISE_PED_TRAFFIC_COEFF.label: Pedestrian Traffic Noise Coefficient
NOISE_PED_TRAFFIC_COEFF.desc: How much pedestrian traffic contributes to the noise heatmap.

PED_NOISE_THRESHOLD.label: Pedestrian Noise Threshold
PED_NOISE_THRESHOLD.desc: Pedestrian traffic above this value contributes to noise.

NOISE_BLUR_SIGMA_M.label: Noise Spread Radius (m)
NOISE_BLUR_SIGMA_M.desc: Gaussian blur radius for the noise heatmap. Higher = wider spread.

NOISE_SATURATION_LEVEL.label: Noise Saturation Level
NOISE_SATURATION_LEVEL.desc: Maximum value for the noise heatmap. Values above this are capped.

POLLUTION_ROAD_TRAFFIC_COEFF.label: Road Traffic Air Pollution Coefficient
POLLUTION_ROAD_TRAFFIC_COEFF.desc: How much road traffic contributes to the air pollution heatmap.

POLLUTION_BLUR_SIGMA_M.label: Air Pollution Spread Radius (m)
POLLUTION_BLUR_SIGMA_M.desc: Gaussian blur radius for the air pollution heatmap.

POLLUTION_SATURATION_LEVEL.label: Air Pollution Saturation Level
POLLUTION_SATURATION_LEVEL.desc: Maximum value for the air pollution heatmap.

UNEMPLOYMENT_CRIME_WEIGHT.label: Unemployment Crime Weight
UNEMPLOYMENT_CRIME_WEIGHT.desc: How strongly unemployment rate affects the crime heatmap.

CRIME_BLUR_SIGMA_M.label: Crime Spread Radius (m)
CRIME_BLUR_SIGMA_M.desc: Gaussian blur radius for the crime heatmap.

CRIME_SATURATION_LEVEL.label: Crime Saturation Level
CRIME_SATURATION_LEVEL.desc: Maximum value for the crime heatmap.

LIVING_MULTIPLIER_MIN.label: Living Environment Multiplier (min)
LIVING_MULTIPLIER_MIN.desc: Rent multiplier when living environment is at its worst.

LIVING_MULTIPLIER_MAX.label: Living Environment Multiplier (max)
LIVING_MULTIPLIER_MAX.desc: Rent multiplier when living environment is ideal.

PEDESTRIAN_SPEED.label: Pedestrian Speed (km/h)
PEDESTRIAN_SPEED.desc: Walking speed used in pathfinding cost calculations.

PATH_KASOKU_LENGTH.label: Vehicle Acceleration Distance (m)
PATH_KASOKU_LENGTH.desc: Acceleration distance for vehicles. Affects speed calculation on short roads.

PATH_ACTIVE_HOURS.label: Road Active Hours per Day (h)
PATH_ACTIVE_HOURS.desc: Hours per day the road is active. Used to convert traffic volume.

ROAD_MANY_TRAFFIC_THRESHOLD.label: Road Traffic Bonus Saturation Threshold
ROAD_MANY_TRAFFIC_THRESHOLD.desc: Road traffic above this value gives maximum retail sales bonus.

PED_MANY_TRAFFIC_THRESHOLD.label: Pedestrian Traffic Bonus Saturation Threshold
PED_MANY_TRAFFIC_THRESHOLD.desc: Pedestrian traffic above this value gives maximum retail sales bonus.

RESOURCE_EFFICIENCY_THRESHOLD.label: Natural Resource Efficiency Threshold
RESOURCE_EFFICIENCY_THRESHOLD.desc: Extraction efficiency stays near 1.0 above this resource remaining ratio. Drops sharply below.
